config._written: 2026-10-19, before any collision group or within-group outcome was computed. Only the column names, the variant notation types and the replicate counts had been looked at.
config.question: When two PTEN variants have the same reduced amino-acid sequence, how much of the measured abundance variation can no predictor that reads only the reduced sequence recover?

dataset.name: PTEN VAMP-seq
dataset.publication: Matreyek et al. 2018, Multiplex assessment of protein variant abundance by massively parallel sequencing, Nature Genetics, doi:10.1038/s41588-018-0122-z
dataset.license: CC0 1.0 (public domain), as stated in the MaveDB record

config.assay: VAMP-seq: each PTEN variant is fused to EGFP; cells are sorted into bins by the EGFP to mCherry ratio; a score is a weighted average of the variant's bin frequencies (MaveDB method text).
config.condition: single condition: the one MaveDB score set

background.sequence_source: translation of the MaveDB target DNA sequence; must equal UniProt P60484 exactly, or the run stops

outcome.units: unitless abundance score; wild type = 1, mean of nonsense variants = 0 (min-max normalised by the authors)
outcome.direction: higher = more PTEN protein in the cell
outcome.definition_check: score must equal the mean of the non-missing replicate columns score1..score8, and expts must equal their count; the run stops if not

uncertainty_fields.sd: sample standard deviation of the replicate scores (checked against the replicate columns with ddof=1)
uncertainty_fields.se: standard error of the variant mean = sd / sqrt(expts) (checked)
uncertainty_fields.expts: number of replicate experiments with a score for the variant

encodings.composition: exact amino-acid count vector of the 20-letter sequence (control)

inclusion: hgvs_pro matches p.<Ref><Pos><Alt> with three-letter codes of the 20 standard amino acids and Ref != Alt (single missense substitution)
Ref equals the reference residue at Pos and 1 <= Pos <= 403

exclusion_reasons.synonymous: p.<Ref><Pos>= : no change to the protein sequence; kept out of the primary analysis and summarised separately
exclusion_reasons.malformed: hgvs_pro does not parse as a single substitution
exclusion_reasons.nonstandard_residue: Ref or Alt is not one of the 20 standard amino acids
exclusion_reasons.reference_mismatch: Ref does not match the reference residue, or Pos is outside the protein
exclusion_reasons.wild_type_anchor: the MaveDB row '_wt': score 1 in every replicate because the authors set wild type to 1; it is the scale's anchor, not a measurement with noise (added 2026-10-19, after the first run, which listed it as 'malformed'; this renames the reason only, the row was excluded either way)
exclusion_reasons.duplicate_sequence: a second row giving the same full protein sequence; replicate scores would be pooled, not counted as a second variant

config.grouping: (assay, condition, background, full encoded sequence); membership checked by exact string equality of the encoded sequence
config.weighting: one weight per distinct protein sequence; a variant's outcome is its mean over replicates
primary_statistics: floor_mse = sum over groups of sum over members of (y_i - group mean)^2, divided by N (all included variants; singleton groups give 0)
collided_mse = the same sum divided by the number of variants in groups of 2 or more
total_variance = mean of (y_i - overall mean)^2 over the same N variants (ddof 0, equal weight)
the same numbers for the group holding the reference's encoded sequence alone, for the other groups alone, and for groups split by position (same-position subset)

noise_procedure.per_variant_noise: se_i^2, the estimated variance of variant i's mean over its replicates
noise_procedure.expected_noise_sse: sum over groups of (1 - 1/n_g) * sum over members of se_i^2. This is the expected within-group sum of squares if every member of a group had the same true score and errors were independent between variants (derivation in the report).
noise_procedure.noise_ratio: observed within-group SSE / expected_noise_sse; above 1 means more spread than measurement noise alone predicts
noise_procedure.noise_adjusted_floor_mse: (observed SSE - expected_noise_sse) / N; an estimate, not a bound

bootstrap.unit: sequence position (all variants at a position are drawn together). A position drawn m times gives each of its variants weight m; group means, sums of squares, total variance and the noise term use these weights (weighted noise term: sum w_i se_i^2 - sum w_i^2 se_i^2 / W_g, since copies share one error). A group counts as a collision only if it holds two or more distinct sequences with weight above 0.
bootstrap._amended: 2026-10-19, before any outcome was computed: replaced 'copies kept apart except in the reference group', which cannot be applied to composition groups (they span positions) and is not a consistent grouping rule, with weights.
bootstrap.generalises_to: other positions of PTEN drawn like the measured ones, in this assay; not other proteins or assays

config.practical_tolerance_note: No prediction-error tolerance is established for this assay, and none was supplied. The result is descriptive, with no pass/fail claim. As a descriptive aid only, the report counts collision groups holding both a 'low' and a 'wt-like' variant under the authors' own abundance_class labels.

kmer_check.sketch: sourmash 4.9 MinHash, scaled=1, seed 42 (the hash kmerseek uses for these two alphabets)
kmer_check.examples: for each encoding: the 3 groups with the largest outcome range (labelled as selected extremes) and 3 groups drawn at random (seed 347)

stop_rule.inconclusive: fewer than 30 collision groups or fewer than 100 variants in collision groups, or no replicate-based se
stop_rule.detectable: lower end of the 95% bootstrap interval of noise_ratio is above 1
stop_rule.practical: with no tolerance, a detectable result is reported as 'detectable information loss, but practical importance is not established'

config.noise_model_check: Synonymous variants all give the wild-type protein. If the variance of their scores is much larger than their mean se^2, the replicate-based se misses some variation (DNA-level effects or errors shared by all replicates), and noise_ratio is overstated by that amount. Reported, not used to change the rule.
sensitivity: add one wild-type record whose outcome is the mean of the synonymous variants' scores
